_comment: No secrets or product data here. ADO_ORG is read from the shell that launches Claude Code (not from .env). Cross-platform `npx` launcher — works on macOS, Linux and WSL out of the box; Windows users who hit an `npx` ENOENT can wrap each command with `cmd /c` (see README.md). ADO is optional: without it the tracker-write steps draft locally and every other workflow still works.
